name: Profile Details Scraper for LinkedIn + EMAIL (No Cookies)
description: Enrich ONE known person from their LinkedIn profile — name, headline, current role, company, education, and contact email. For a single known individual, not filtered prospecting.

fields.name: username
fields.description: LinkedIn profile username (e.g., 'neal-mohan' from linkedin.com/in/neal-mohan) or URL or Urn (e.g: ACoAAAPCNL4BRjB2mlrFKePwdFvNMtb2ekzpEWw)

fields.name: includeEmail
fields.description: Whether to include email address in the profile data extraction if available
